title: PlanDims Command
description: The user's own plan dimensions, stored by Forsk ids and drawn at the next Print. add: across two or more parallel walls (refs, or the picked walls and their doors and windows). remove: the ids given, or all. list: what is stored.

ids.description: remove only: which dimensions (U01, U02). Omit to remove every one.

refs.description: add only: walls by forsk:id and openings by their marker's forsk:id. Omit to use the selection.
